messages:
alex: Quick experiment proposal — offer $50 voucher to a small set of design partners to encourage faster setup & feedback. Goal: boost activation and get richer qualitative notes. Thoughts? cc @maria @devon
maria: +1 idea. What's the pilot N and selection criteria?
devon: propose N=25 for the initial pilot, stratified by product use case (embeddings, chat, private). Need a CS owner for follow-ups.
sam: Suggested success metrics: activation rate (first config + API call), tokens in first 14 days, and a short qualitative checklist completion. Duration?
alex: 2-week active window. Primary metric = activation rate lift vs control. Secondary = avg tokens/day and feedback completion. Report at day 14 and day 30.
lisa: Can we automate voucher issuance? @jordan-bot can mint codes via the voucher flow. Also need redemption terms (legal).
jordan-bot: bot: Voucher flow ready. Command: `/voucher create --amount=50 --count=25 --tag=dp-pilot-mar2026`
maria: Draft invite copy (short) — dropping it here for quick review:
```
Subject: Invitation to a short design partner pilot — $50 voucher
Hi [Name],

We're running a short pilot to refine our private deployment onboarding. If you join and complete a few short checks over 2 weeks you'll receive a $50 voucher.

Sign up: <link>
Quick ask: try the "model pinning" flow and run the 3 checklist prompts attached.

Thanks,
Alex
```
devon: Checklist I suggest: 1) End-to-end onboarding time (minutes), 2) Pin a model variant and do a canary rollout, 3) Exercise cache warmup and measure tail latency, 4) Take a screenshot of console + fill short survey.
sam: Survey Qs (3 quick): a) Was setup clear? (Y/No/Somewhat) b) Biggest blocker? (free text) c) Would you use this in prod? (Y/N) + optional free comment.
alex: Rollout gating: must have CS rep assigned (Lisa), Eng oncall aware (Devon), and legal sign-off on voucher terms. If any missing -> pause.
lisa: I will own CS follow-ups and do the day-3 / day-10 checkins. I'll prep the participant CSV and hand it off.
maria: Tracking: create a dashboard filtered by cohort tag `dp-pilot-mar2026`. Compare to a control cohort `dp-invite-control`. Metric list: activation_rate, tokens_14d, feedback_completion_rate, qual_score.
devon: Can we add automated nudges at day 3 and day 10? Use `/remind` or the outreach runner to send short reminders.
alex: Schedule proposal: Invite send Mon 2026-03-30, close invites Apr 6, 14-day active window ends Apr 20, final report Apr 27. Need signoffs by Fri EOD.
sam: Signoffs required: Product (alex), CS (lisa), Eng (devon), Legal (maria to ping legal).
maria: I'll ping legal now about voucher T&Cs. Also flagged: consider A/B of voucher size, but small N will reduce power.
alex: Agree — for this pilot keep N=25 single arm to avoid fragmentation. If signals strong we'll run an A/B next run.
lisa: I'll draft the invite list and share CSV by Thu EOD; will include use-case tag per row.
alex: OK if no objections I'll lock the copy and enable the voucher command tomorrow. :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
devon: :rocket:
